title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: Minor: the gloss of μ_α as a number of 'edges incident to α' would undercount loops (a loop contributes 2). The precise version uses Ã_α, the half-edges with origin α, which is correct. The manuscript probably reads 'sortant de α' (outgoing arcs), which is also correct.

Implicit requirement, made explicit on the next page: each G(α) must be connected, with total genus (vertex genera plus b_1) equal to g_α, so that G' has genus g. Not stated on this page but standard.

ideas.what: Construction of the specialization G' of a stable graph G by substituting a stable graph G(α) of type (g_α, I_α ⊔ Ã_α) at each vertex α, gluing along legs/half-edges
ideas.modern_name: Vertex insertion / graph substitution for stable graphs; edge contraction G' → G; composition in the modular operad of stable graphs; stratification poset of the boundary of M̄_{g,n}
ideas.usually_credited_to: Implicit in Deligne–Mumford (1969) and Knudsen; formalized by Getzler–Kapranov (Modular operads, 1998), Kontsevich–Manin, Arbarello–Cornalba–Griffiths (GAC II)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses the 'structure à l'infini' / Teichmüller tower and the boundary stratification of M̂_{g,ν} qualitatively, but not this explicit combinatorial formula

ideas.what: Description of the strata of M̂_G = ∏ M̂_{g_α, Î_α} as indexed by families of MD-graphs G(α), i.e. a product decomposition of the closure of a stratum
ideas.modern_name: Gluing map ξ_G: ∏_v M̄_{g(v), n(v)} → M̄_{g,n} and its compatibility with the boundary stratification
ideas.usually_credited_to: Knudsen, Deligne–Mumford; standard in GAC II, Getzler–Kapranov

deep.surprise_reason: A careful, correct, but entirely standard combinatorial description of vertex substitution / edge contraction for Deligne–Mumford stable graphs. It is notable only as Grothendieck's own (early, independent) formalization with half-edge/involution notation, as later used in modular operad literature; nothing missing from the record.
transcription_corrections: First line likely 'avec ces G(α) eux-mêmes' (or 'avec les G(α) eux-mêmes') rather than 'avoir en G(α) eux-mêmes'.
The line 'Î = ⊔ Î_α = ⊔ I(α)' is an annotation written under the brace of (Ã ⊔ I), identifying Ã ⊔ I with ⊔ Î_α; it is not a separate equation.
'(= Î(α))' is a brace under 'Î_α ⊔ Ã(α)', i.e. Î_α ⊔ Ã(α) = Î(α).
'poids [?] μ_α' and 'incidentes à [?] α': the manuscript seems to read something like 'μ̃_α = ordre de α = nb d'arcs de G sortant de α' (outgoing half-edges); 'incidentes à' is doubtful.
'Donc "la recette" {+"pratique"+}': the word in quotes is hard to read; 'recette' is plausible.
